title: Explainable residual CNN-Mamba hybrid for lung cancer histopathology: code, recovered LC25000 groups, splits and results
description:
Code and released data for a leakage-controlled study of an explainable residual CNN-Mamba hybrid on lung histopathology. The archive contains the architecture and its comparators, the recovery of the 716 LC25000 source-image groups, the LungHist700 patient-level folds and external-test splits, the per-image predictions, the measured explanation metrics (pathway attribution and deletion-insertion faithfulness), the cost benchmark, a standalone state-space comparator (VMamba-T) and the learning-rate and random-map sensitivity analyses, the cluster-aware statistics, and the scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the paper.

The datasets analysed are LC25000 (Borkowski et al., 2019) and LungHist700 (Diosdado et al., 2024, CC BY 4.0); neither is redistributed here. The grouping of LC25000 used in the sensitivity analysis comes from LC25000-clean (Batchkala et al., 2024).
